## Personality

Belinda possesses a joyful demeanor and is consistently welcoming, greeting others with a broad grin. Exceptionally obedient and agreeable toward her mistress, she readily complies with any instruction given to her.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018)_

## History

Belinda serves as the young helper to Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage). While picking early strawberries with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Belinda voices her concerns regarding Miss Rosalind's poor health and persistent melancholic mood. She is later delighted when [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) arrives at the cottage and reunites with [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) as her lover.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +10 more_

## Quotes

> "I stole a glance through the kitchen window . . . and he is remarkably handsome . . . and precisely the proper age for Miss Rosalind. And oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, do you suppose there would be any great harm in eavesdropping at the door?"
>
> — Belinda — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Belinda — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "Indeed, ma’am. Step inside, ma’am. I shall inform Miss Rosalind of your arrival, ma’am. Her ladyship is on the upper floor, ma’am."
>
> — Belinda — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)

> "There is no poetry in a wedding. My goodness, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, tears are falling from your eyes! For what reason?"
>
> — Belinda — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074)

> "and no matter what takes place from this point on, they are wedded safe and sound. Ma’am, the rice bags can be found in the pantry, the worn shoes sit behind the door, and the whipping cream has been placed on the sullar steps."
>
> — Belinda — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--harcourt.md)

Belinda lives in the same household as [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), where the two share a close friendship. Belinda confided her concerns about Miss Rosalind's melancholic mood and failing health to [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) while they were picking strawberries, prompting [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) to stay at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to help. The pair later celebrated together when [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) arrived and embraced [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) in the garden, and they subsequently worked together to assist with the preparations and cleanup for Rosalind's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +14 more_

- Friend of — close friends residing in the same household  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--nell-harcourt.md)

Belinda and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends who met when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally discovered [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) while walking through the autumn woods and was invited inside for tea by Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). During a later visit, Belinda shared her concerns regarding Miss Rosalind's health and melancholic state with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), which motivated [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to stay at the cottage to offer help. The two friends subsequently shared in the joy of [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) Stanhope's romantic arrival and worked alongside one another to prepare for Miss Rosalind's garden wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), +5 more_

- Friend of — close friends  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
